newsitem.title: USA: Mass. jobless rate in May rises 0.1 pct to 4.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mass. jobless rate in May rises 0.1 pct to 4.2 pct.

text.p: The unemployment rate for Massachusetts in May was 4.2 percent, up from April's 4.1 percent, the state's Division of Employment and Training said Friday.

"Our year-to-date average unemployment rate for 1997 is 4.0 percent, considerably lower than the U.S. average for the last five months of 5.1 percent," the division's Deputy Director Nils L. Nordberg said.
Nordberg said the payroll survey of Massachusetts jobs in May showed an estimated 11,700 jobs gain over the month, and a gain of 74,200 more jobs than one year ago in May 1996.
The national jobless rate for May, announced June 6, was 4.8 percent, down from 4.9 percent in April.
